## Plan your visit

[![Skissernas Museums fasad.](https://skissernasmuseum.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Fasad-Nov-1-Foto-Emma-Krantz-himmel.jpg)](https://skissernasmuseum.se/en/visit/opening-hours-admissions/)

### [Opening Hours & Admissions](https://skissernasmuseum.se/en/visit/opening-hours-admissions/)

The museum have generous opening hours and offer a number of different discounts and ticket variants. Free admission to the museum every Thursday evening!

[![En kvinna tittar på konst. I bakgrunden en skulptur föreställande en kvinna.](https://skissernasmuseum.se/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/Besok-Museet-04576-Johan-Persson-utvald.jpg)](https://skissernasmuseum.se/en/visit/before-your-visit/)

### [Plan your visit](https://skissernasmuseum.se/en/visit/before-your-visit/)

Welcome to Skissernas Museum! Here you’ll find practical information to make the most of your museum experience.

[![En kopparfärgad gryta med sås ett fat med bläckfisk.](https://skissernasmuseum.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/hemsida-Blackfisk.jpg)](https://skissernasmuseum.se/en/visit/eat-and-drink/)

### [Eat & Drink](https://skissernasmuseum.se/en/visit/eat-and-drink/)

Enjoy flavors with artistic excellence! Scandinavian cuisine rooted in locally sourced ingredients and a genuine love of the craft.
